title: Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: iOS Software Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x)
description:
Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development.

title: AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights
description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. 

What We Can Offer 

You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights 

You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there. 

What You Will Do 

  • Design and implement decoupled data supply chains, spanning landing zones, quality and transformation layers, and consumption layers, to ensure consistently high-quality data reaches analytics and AI systems 

  • Implement and document business KPIs as defined by business stakeholders, ensuring full metric traceability; define, implement, and document technical KPIs for AI application performance in collaboration with the data architect, ensuring explainability and observability across all AI-driven outputs 

  • Build and maintain a semantic layer that enables AI-based insight generation, bridging structured data assets with natural-language querying and large language model (LLM) integration 

  • Lead the expansion of existing BI reporting with AI-supported, RAG-driven analytics, progressively complementing manual report runs with dynamic, contextual insight delivery 

  • Develop and maintain data models, transformations, and pipelines using industry-standard tooling, complementing existing data infrastructure and ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability throughout 

  • Expose data assets and AI services via well-designed APIs, supporting consumption by both technical and non-technical consumers 

  • Act as a frontline coach and enabler for business users and citizen analysts, building AI and data literacy across the organisation and supporting adoption of AI-assisted workflows 

  • Embed security-by-design principles into all analytics and AI assets, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse 

  • Collaborate across IT, data, security, and business functions to ensure analytics outputs are governed, compliant with EU AI Act and GDPR requirements, and aligned to Intersnack's data sovereignty standards 


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing multi-layer data architectures, including landing zones, transformation layers, and consumption layers

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting or transformation language (e.g., Python, dbt) for data modelling and pipeline development

  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, vector stores, and RAG patterns, including the ability to build semantic layers and design LLM-integrated workflows using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph

  • Experience with BI and analytics platforms (e.g., Qlik, Power BI, or equivalent) and a clear understanding of how to complement existing reporting with AI-assisted delivery

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or AWS data and AI services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, AWS Glue, SageMaker, or equivalent)

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with and understand non-technical business users, translating AI and data concepts into business language with clarity and confidence

  • Solid understanding of AI security fundamentals, including risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and chain-reaction errors in AI pipelines

  • Awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks, including GDPR, the EU AI Act, and data sovereignty principles applicable in the EU context

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage

Valuable Experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Purview, or OneLake for unified data governance and discovery, and with Microsoft Foundry for building and deploying LLM-integrated workflows and AI applications

  • Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or procurement environments, with an understanding of the data and reporting challenges specific to these domains

  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical application of AI ethics frameworks

description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

title: Customer Success Manager, EMEA
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote, within EMEA time zones.

The impact you will have:

At Notabene, the success of our customers drives everything that we do, and our Customer Success team is at the heart of that. You will own a book of customers across EMEA, from crypto-native exchanges and payment providers through to the financial institutions and fintechs now launching digital asset products.

Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them. The commercial conversation sits with you, which means renewals, pricing and upsells are yours to run.

You are also a technical point of contact for your customers. These conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • Your customers are live and using the product, and the ones at risk were identified early

  • You have found and qualified upsell opportunities inside your existing customers, and converted a good number of them

  • Customers come to you first, on their compliance programme and on their commercial relationship with us

  • You can demonstrate real knowledge of our product and of the wider industry

What you will be doing:

  • Owning the post-sales journey for your customers: onboarding, adoption, business reviews, renewal and upsell

  • Running your own renewals and upsells, including pricing and the conversation with the economic buyer

  • Guiding customers through their Travel Rule programmes and their stablecoin payment products

  • Working directly with customer integration teams: API documentation, test calls, transaction and webhook data, and a clear diagnosis when something is stuck

  • Monitoring usage, engagement and risk signals, and acting on them with a clear plan well before they become a renewal problem

  • Finding growth inside your existing customers across adjacent teams, entities and products, and working with Sales on the net-new ones

  • Building relationships across compliance, operations and engineering, so the relationship never rests on one contact

  • Bringing customer and competitor insight back to product, sales and marketing

  • Keeping records current in HubSpot

  • Some on-call duty outside office hours

What you bring:

  • Based in EMEA, able to cover customers across the region

  • Around 5 years in Customer Success or Account Management at a crypto, fintech or regtech SaaS company, or in another complex technical market, managing your own book of customers

  • Commercial ownership. You have run your own renewals and upsells and negotiated pricing, without passing the deal back to Sales

  • Some technical range. You can work through API documentation, read a request and response, and form a view on why an integration is behaving the way it is

  • Experience across a mix of customers, from mid-market through to enterprise

  • Experience across the full lifecycle, from onboarding through to expansion

  • Exposure to compliance-driven or regulated environments

  • A doer. You own the detail yourself, and you move without waiting for a process to exist

  • Good judgement with people and real interest in solving their problems

  • Comfortable working autonomously and getting stuck in

Nice to Have

  • Travel Rule, stablecoin payments or digital asset compliance experience

  • Experience with banks and regulated financial institutions entering digital assets

  • Having built Customer Success processes and playbooks from scratch

title: Founding lead Product Designer
description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions.

We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates.

We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

Tasks

User Research & Discovery

  • Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.
  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.
  • Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.
  • Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 

Product & Experience Design

  • What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.
  • Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.
  • Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.
  • Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.
  • Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.
  • Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

Requirements

  • 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.
  • A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.
  • A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.
  • Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.
  • Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows.
  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust.
  • Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work.
  • Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.
  • You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early.
  • Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work.

Benefits

  • A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.

  • Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.

  • A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.

  • A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

  • If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning.

  • Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Qantev is the most advanced AI Platform dedicated to helping health insurers deliver superior healthcare and claims experience to their members. By leveraging insurers' historical health claims data and applying advanced Machine Learning techniques and Generative AI, Qantev predicts patient journeys, optimizes healthcare outcomes and streamlines healthcare payers operations

Founded in 2019 and backed by top investors and industry leaders, Qantev has over 60 talented and diverse professionals based in Paris and Hong Kong, serving clients across Europe, the United States, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East.

If you are passionate about technology and the insurance industry, join Qantev and be a part of revolutionizing the insurance claims landscape with AI-driven solutions!

We are seeking a client-facing Solution Architect to own our demo experience and the technical design of our solutions for prospects and clients. The role is based in Paris.

Tasks

The Team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join our Tech team, and as our Solution Architect, you will be the technical bridge between our clients, the Sales team and our Product, Data Science and Engineering teams, and the go-to expert on how Qantev's platform fits into each insurer's environment.

About the role 🚀

  • Demo Ownership: Design, build and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of Qantev's AI-driven claims platform, from first-meeting demos to in-depth deep dives with insurers' business, medical and IT teams.
  • Demo Environments: Own and maintain our demo environments, scripts and datasets, making sure they are reliable, aligned with the latest product releases and adaptable to each client's market and use cases.
  • Proofs of Concept: Scope, plan and run POCs and pilots on client data together with our Data Science and Engineering teams, define success criteria and present the results to client decision-makers.
  • RFP/RFI & Security Reviews: Own the technical sections of RFPs/RFIs, as well as IT, security and compliance questionnaires (architecture, hosting, GDPR and local data regulations).
  • Trusted Advisor: Act as the technical point of contact for clients throughout the sales cycle, build strong relationships with their IT and business leaders, and ensure a smooth handover to the delivery team.
  • Assets & Enablement: Create and maintain reusable assets (demo scripts, architecture diagrams, technical documentation, recorded demos) and train the Sales team to deliver first-level demos.
  • Feedback Loop: Bring client and market feedback to the Product and Engineering teams to inform feature enhancements and roadmap planning.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a solution architect, solutions engineer, pre-sales , ideally in SaaS, AI/data, insurance or healthcare.
  • Education: Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. .
  • Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Spanish, Portuguese or an Asian language are a plus.
  • Proven track record of delivering engaging, high-impact demos to both C-level and technical audiences, with strong storytelling skills.
  • Solid technical background: software and cloud architecture (AWS, Azure or GCP), APIs and integration patterns, data pipelines, security; hands-on with SQL and/or Python to prepare demo data.
  • Good understanding of AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI concepts. Knowledge of health insurance or claims processes is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical topics simple and convincing, both orally and in writing.
  • Client-first mindset: you enjoy being in front of clients, listening to their challenges and shaping tailored solutions.
  • Autonomous and structured, able to manage several opportunities in parallel in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America) as required.

Benefits

Professional Growth & Impact:

Opportunity to join a challenging environment among top-notch engineers and experienced entrepreneurs.

Develop a deep understanding of the health insurance industry.

Take part in scaling a global tech start-up.

title: Graduate Program Dirigeant [H/F]
description:
Graduate Program Dirigeant — Alfeor

Promotion mars 2027

Le poste que vous visez : dirigeant d’une PME industrielle.

Alfeor réunit des PME industrielles de la filière nucléaire et des filières souveraines (défense et aéronautique) : traitement de surface, usinage de précision, mécanosoudure, essais métallurgiques, éléments de fixation et instruments de mesure et de contrôle des fluides. Créé en 2023. Aujourd’hui 5 sites, 250 salariés, 40 M€ de chiffre d’affaires. Cible 2030 : 250 M€.

Il n’existe pas d’école pour diriger une PME industrielle. Nous en avons construit une, sur le terrain.

Le parcours — 18 à 24 mois, 4 phases

Premier site

1. Opérateur d’atelier, 1 mois. Usinage, fraisage, chaudronnerie. Vous apprenez le geste avant de parler du reste.

2. Chef d’équipe ou de secteur production, 4 à 5 mois. Une équipe de 3 à 10 personnes, la performance de cette équipe est votre responsabilité.

3. Chargé d’affaires, 4 à 6 mois. Vous suivez une commande de la réception matière à la livraison client. Délais, marge, exigences de la filière nucléaire.

Changement de site, au bout d’environ 12 mois

Vous avez vu un atelier, un collectif, une affaire de bout en bout. Votre second site est choisi avec vous, en fonction de vos appétences et des besoins du groupe.

4. Responsable de la transformation, 9 à 12 mois, au CODIR. Vous êtes le relais du directeur général : chantiers d’amélioration continue, plans capex, stratégie achats, développement commercial. Vous portez un à deux projets en autonomie complète.

Entre les phases, des semaines de formation : fondamentaux de la filière nucléaire, excellence opérationnelle, pilotage financier, management et RH. Revue de performance hebdomadaire avec votre DG, puis trimestrielle avec le groupe.

À la sortie

Un poste de direction dans une de nos filiales : production, achats, commerce, RH, pôle nucléaire, avec l’objectif d’évoluer vers la direction générale à terme.

Ce poste n’est pas garanti. Le programme est sélectif et évalué à chaque rotation. Nous prenons l’engagement de vous former et de vous exposer ; vous prenez celui de faire vos preuves.

Une première promotion

Alfeor est un groupe industriel de dirigeants et d’équipes qui partagent une conviction : l’industrie de demain ne se décrète pas, elle se construit maintenant, sur le terrain, atelier par atelier.

C’est la première promotion de ce programme. Nous l’avons conçu autour de deux principes : le terrain d’abord, et des responsabilités réelles dès les premiers mois. Une équipe à diriger, une commande à tenir, des chantiers dont vous répondez.

Votre profil

– Bac+5, Grande école d'ingénieur ou de commerce (Arts et Métiers, Centrale, HEC, ESSEC, ESCP), 0 à 2 ans d'expérience

– Deux parcours mènent au même poste : un profil technique qui apprend le pilotage, un profil gestion qui apprend l'atelier. Nous recrutons les deux.

– Vous voulez faire plutôt qu'analyser. Vous acceptez de commencer là où l'IA ne prend pas encore sa place : l'atelier.

– Vous savez tenir un problème dans la durée : le poser, l'affecter, le relancer, le clore. Sur un site industriel, un sujet non suivi est un sujet perdu.

– Vous êtes mobile en France. Vos deux sites d'affectation dépendront aussi des acquisitions d'Alfeor en 2027. Nos sites sont souvent éloignés des grandes villes : vous y passerez plusieurs mois loin de votre réseau habituel.

– Vous visez un poste de direction en PME industrielle, sans avoir encore l'expérience du terrain qui le permet..

Concrètement

– CDI, prise de poste en mars 2027 selon disponibilité

– Affectation : un site du groupe, précisé en cours de process

title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
description:
Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires.

Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action.

C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation.

Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique.

PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens.

Vos missions

Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier.

Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes.

Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients.

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients.

Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti.

Concrètement, vous serez amené à :

  • Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails).
  • Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé.
  • Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus.
  • Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées.
  • Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit.
  • Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité.

Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement. Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui aime construire des relations de confiance dans la durée.

Ingénieur(e) de formation ou diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 dans les domaines de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de la thermique ou de l'immobilier, vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de l'accompagnement client.

Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques de vos interlocuteurs, les accompagner dans leurs projets et leur apporter des conseils concrets. Curieux(se), à l'écoute et pédagogue, vous appréciez autant les échanges humains que les sujets techniques.

Une première expérience dans le conseil, la gestion de projet, le Customer Success ou l'accompagnement client constitue un véritable atout.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre capacité à :

  • Créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients et communiquer avec aisance, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Comprendre les enjeux techniques, réglementaires et patrimoniaux liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments, ou avoir l'envie de développer rapidement cette expertise.
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et d'une réelle envie d'apprendre dans un secteur en constante évolution.
  • Organiser votre activité et prioriser efficacement les sollicitations d'un portefeuille clients.
  • Travailler en équipe et mobiliser les bonnes expertises internes lorsque la situation l'exige.
  • Être à l'aise avec les outils numériques et les environnements SaaS.

Une connaissance des secteurs de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de l'immobilier ou des collectivités territoriales sera appréciée.

Enfin, si vous aimez décrocher votre téléphone pour échanger avec vos clients, créer une relation durable et les accompagner bien au-delà de la simple utilisation d'un logiciel, vous vous sentirez probablement à votre place chez Lowit.

Avantages

  • Un environnement de travail jeune et dynamique
  • Remboursement à 50% des transports en commun
  • Tickets restaurant (10€/jour)

title: Product manager - gestion des projets (CDI)
description:
🧱 À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs, de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers. Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle.

Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles.

Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier.

Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément. Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux.

C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks. Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

C’est là que tu interviens.

👉 Ce que tu vas owner

  • Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.
  • Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.
  • Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.
  • Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.
  • T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.
  • Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.
  • Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.
  • Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad. Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

👥 La squad

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.

Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés.

C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features.

Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande.

Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Product Management avec déjà une vraie autonomie sur ton périmètre.
  • Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit ou un environnement où il fallait comprendre le métier avant de construire la solution. Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle.
  • Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information
  • Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer.
  • Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes.
  • Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles.
  • Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process

❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si

  • Tu as besoin d’un framework très établi pour fonctionner.
  • Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte.
  • Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature.
  • Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte.
  • Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet.
  • Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème.

Avantages

🚀 Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant

La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme.

Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape.

Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir.

L'offre

👉 CDI, temps plein.

👉 De vrais sujets, un vrai impact : produit régulé, vraies conséquences quand on se plante.

👉 Beaucoup d’ownership : tu travailleras directement avec les personnes qui font le produit et tu auras une vraie influence sur ce qu’on construit.

👉Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance : tu arrives à un moment où l’organisation Product est encore suffisamment petite pour que tu puisses réellement contribuer à la construire.

👉 Salaire compétitif, assurance santé moderne, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu'il te faut.

👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau).

Derrière cette croissance, il y a un produit B2C régulé, des flux financiers réels, des enjeux forts de sécurité, de fiabilité et de cohérence des données. Ce qui part en production peut être utilisé par des milliers d’investisseurs dans les heures qui suivent.

Côté Engineering, on fonctionne avec une équipe autonome, proche du produit et du business. On attend de chacun qu’il comprenne les problèmes en profondeur, prenne des décisions et contribue directement à la qualité de ce qu’on construit.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoindras une équipe Engineering de 10 ingénieurs, avec un CTO qui code au quotidien. Côté Produit : 2 Designers et 2 PM.

L’équipe grandit, les enjeux aussi. On cherche aujourd’hui un Engineering Manager qui travaillera étroitement avec le CTO, à la fois sur le management de l’équipe, son organisation et les sujets techniques structurants.

Tu participeras aux roadmaps Engineering, à la composition des squads, à la définition des objectifs et aux prochains recrutements, tout en restant proche du code et du produit.

Chez Bricks, devenir manager ne veut pas dire s’éloigner de la technique : tu dois pouvoir entrer dans une discussion d’architecture, challenger une décision, faire une code review utile ou débloquer un sujet complexe.

🧱 Ce que tu vas owner

👉 Construire l’organisation Engineering avec le CTO : faire évoluer la composition des équipes, les objectifs, les façons de travailler et participer activement aux recrutements.

👉 Manager et faire progresser les ingénieurs au quotidien : 1:1, feedback, accompagnement, progression, exigence technique. Comprendre ce qui bloque quelqu’un et l’aider à passer au palier suivant.

👉 Rester connecté au code et au produit. Tu ne coderas pas nécessairement toute la journée, mais tu dois pouvoir entrer dans la codebase, participer aux reviews et prendre part aux décisions d’architecture.

👉 Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe shippe vite et bien. Identifier les blocages, arbitrer, clarifier les responsabilités et faire évoluer le process uniquement lorsqu’il apporte de la valeur.

👉 Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence technique. Modélisation du domaine, architecture, qualité des données, sécurité, performance : tu aides l’équipe à prendre les bonnes décisions là où elles comptent vraiment.

🛠️ La stack

Tu dois être suffisamment proche de notre environnement technique pour pouvoir intervenir réellement dans les discussions et dans le code :

👉 TypeScript end-to-end. Les types sont de la documentation qui s’exécute.

👉 Node monolithe, Screaming Architecture.

👉 Postgres (NeonDB) avec Graphile pour les queues ACID. Redis pour ce qui doit être rapide.

👉 Zod, Kysely, ts-pattern - type-safety du front à la DB.

👉 Better Auth.

👉 Railway pour l’infra.

👉 Github CI, Datadog, K6.

👉 React Native + RN Web côté front : une seul codebase web + mobile.

Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir utilisé exactement chacune de ces technos. En revanche, Node/TypeScript et une vraie profondeur backend sont importants : on cherche quelqu’un capable de challenger techniquement l’équipe, pas seulement de la manager.

🤖 IA-first mindset

L’IA est partout dans notre quotidien. 100**% des workflows passe par elle** : Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Cursor, Automations, etc.

Et pour un Engineering Manager, l’enjeu va plus loin que sa propre utilisation : tu dois comprendre comment l’IA transforme la façon de manager, coder, de reviewer, de tester, de recruter et de faire progresser une équipe Engineering.

Si tu vois encore l’IA comme secondaire, ce poste n’est pas pour toi.

title: Clinical Data Manager 50%
description:
Join HEMEX, A European Contract Research Organization based in Liestal, Switzerland, dedicated to advancing global healthcare through innovative biotechnology research. As a Medical Monitor specializing in Pharmacovigilance and Medical Device Safety, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and efficacy of groundbreaking pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech solutions. With our comprehensive clinical development services, including regulatory support and quality assurance, you'll have the opportunity to work on multinational clinical trials and contribute to the translation of novel concepts into market-ready solutions.

Tasks

  • The Clinical Data Manager is responsible for the planning, setup, conduct, cleaning, reconciliation, and closeout of clinical trial databases.
  • The role ensures that clinical trial data are complete, consistent, accurate, traceable, and ready for statistical analysis and database lock.
  • The Clinical Data Manager works closely with Clinical Operations, CRAs, Medical Monitors, Pharmacovigilance, Biostatistics, investigators, and sponsors throughout the study lifecycle.

Functional Responsabilities:

1. Study Setup and Database Build

  • Translate clinical trial protocols and endpoints into electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs).
  • Develop eCRF specifications in alignment with applicable CDISC (CDASH and SDTM) standards where required.
  • Develop and maintain the Data Management Plan (DMP), the Data Validation Plan, and the eCRF Completion Guidelines.
  • Define data handling, data transfer, reconciliation, and data security processes in compliance with applicable data protection requirements (e.g., GDPR and the Swiss FADP).
  • Develop Edit Check Specifications and automated validation rules.
  • Support database configuration and testing.
  • Lead or coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system.
  • Ensure database readiness and documented approval prior to study go-live.
  • Train investigators and site staff on eCRF completion and EDC use, and support kick-off and investigator meetings as required.

2. Study Conduct and Data Cleaning

  • Monitor incoming clinical trial data for completeness, consistency, and quality.
  • Review data listings and identify missing, inconsistent, or implausible data.
  • Generate, review, and track data queries to clinical trial sites.
  • Use R programming to support data cleaning, validation, and preparation of clean datasets for Biostatistics, preferably following SDTM standards (ADaM derivations remain with Biostatistics), with appropriate documentation and quality control.
  • Monitor query resolution and ensure that outstanding discrepancies are appropriately addressed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of data cleaning activities.
  • Prepare data management status and metrics reports (e.g., query rates, data-entry timelines) for the project team and sponsors, and support risk-based quality management.

3. External Data Reconciliation

  • Coordinate integration and reconciliation of external data sources with the clinical database.
  • Define and agree data transfer agreements and specifications with external data vendors.
  • Reconcile central laboratory data, ePRO/eCOA data, IRT data, imaging data, and other external datasets where applicable.
  • Ensure that data transfers are complete, accurate, documented, and appropriately version-controlled.

4. Medical Coding

  • Coordinate or perform medical coding of:

  • Adverse events using MedDRA.

  • Medical history using MedDRA.

  • Concomitant medications using WHODrug or applicable standards.

  • Ensure coding is consistent and appropriately reviewed, and that dictionary versions are documented and upgrades are managed in a controlled manner.

  • Resolve coding discrepancies according to predefined procedures.

5. SAE and Safety Data Reconciliation

  • Reconcile serious adverse events between the clinical database (EDC) and the pharmacovigilance/safety database at agreed intervals and prior to interim analyses and database lock.
  • Work closely with Medical Monitors and Pharmacovigilance personnel to investigate discrepancies.
  • Ensure that safety data are complete and consistent across relevant systems.

6. Database Lock and Study Closeout

  • Coordinate the Lock Readiness Review.
  • Confirm that critical data fields are complete.
  • Ensure outstanding queries are closed or appropriately justified.
  • Ensure protocol deviations and relevant data issues are appropriately documented.
  • Coordinate final clean-file review with CRAs, Medical Monitors, Biostatisticians, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Execute or coordinate database lock according to approved procedures.
  • Prepare data cuts and transfers for interim analyses and DSMB/DMC reviews as required.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation of database lock activities.
  • Support archiving and audit readiness, including metadata and audit trail documentation, and filing of data management documents in the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Keep documentation and handover notes up to date so that the named backup can cover planned and unplanned absences.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Pharmacy, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • At least 2 years of experience in clinical data management within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environment.
  • Experience with EDC systems and clinical trial databases.
  • Knowledge of clinical data management processes and database lifecycle management.
  • Experience with eCRF development, edit checks, data cleaning, query management, and database lock.
  • Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug preferred.
  • Knowledge of CDISC (CDASH and SDTM) standards preferred.
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP and clinical research regulations (including requirements for computerized systems and electronic records, and data protection).
  • Experience with R for data cleaning, validation, and listings; Python is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and data quality mindset.
  • Structured and process-oriented working style.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work effectively across Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Medical Monitoring, and Biostatistics.
  • Strong commitment to SOP compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage multiple studies and competing priorities.

Benefits

Flexible working arrangements and hybrid work options
Modern, international and entrepreneurial working environment

Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning

High level of autonomy and responsibility

Collaborative team culture with direct communication and short decision-making paths

Central location with good public transport connections

Opportunity to work with innovative companies and projects in a dynamic industry

title: Succevol ingevuld: Senior growth marketeer @ Snelstart
description:
Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

 

•            Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren

•            Mandaat en vrijheid

•            Locatie: Amersfoort

•            Uren: 32–40 uur

•            Opleidingsniveau: Hbo

•            Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

Motivatie; je optimaliseert wordt blij van groei. En wordt blij van resultaat en je vindt de marketing puzzel leuk en enthousiasmeert je collega’s voor jouw vak en de impact die je maakt.

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk
